title: Argumentative essay
when_to_use: A text that defends one thesis for a reader who does not yet agree.

personas.description: Informed reader who does not share the thesis and reads to find where the argument breaks.

dimensions.name: Thesis
dimensions.question: Can the persona state the thesis in one sentence after reading the first paragraph?

anchors.3: a thesis appears, but only later or in vague terms
anchors.5: the thesis is stated in the first paragraph in one sentence the persona could dispute

dimensions.name: Argument
dimensions.question: Does each section move the thesis forward with a reason?

anchors.1: sections restate the thesis or wander
anchors.3: some sections give a reason, others restate
anchors.5: each section adds one reason, and the strongest objection is answered

dimensions.name: Evidence
dimensions.question: Is each reason backed by a source, a number or a worked example?

anchors.3: some reasons are backed, others asserted
anchors.5: every reason carries a source, a number or a worked example

dimensions.name: Prose
dimensions.question: Can the persona read it once without rereading a sentence?

anchors.1: many sentences need a second read
anchors.3: a few sentences need a second read
anchors.5: no sentence needs a second read

measured.description: word count, within the limit set for the essay
